data.body:
Another occurrence: Gerrit change 2074 (story fcb7-e6e2-7244-42d2), GH Actions run 32555809496, patch set 1. Same signature — py3.13 ubuntu shard only (gw2), 'assert ["run"] == ["ensures", "run"]'; py3.11, py3.12 and macos-py3.13 all green, and the file passes locally both isolated (10 passed) and under xdist -n 4 over tests/interfaces/store/ (436 passed).

Extra datum for the root cause: the CI traceback shows NO captured stderr and no logged warning. mcp_server.main() logs on the except path of its best-effort sweep block, so the sweep was not skipped by a swallowed exception — os.path.isdir(config.tracker_dir()) simply evaluated False. That points at the memoized resolved-Config cache (config.py:187-203, 414-418) serving a neighbour test's tracker.dir rather than at the try/except, which narrows the fix to cache-key/reset scope rather than to the exception handling.
